remarks: This first floor apartment with no steps offers spacious rooms and lots of natural lighting. Located in small condo complex of 6 and convenient to everything. Enter into a foyer with double closets & utility closet, dining area with plenty of room for table & chairs, a galley kitchen w/huge pantry and plenty of cabinets, electric stove, refrigerator & dishwasher. Large Living Room and Bedroom which can easily accommodate a king sized bed w/double closets. Laundry area with full size washer & dryer. Full bath w/tub & shower & linen closet. Central Air and reserved off street parking (2 spots #9 & 10). Recently painted and carpets professionally cleaed. Must have excellent credit, good references, 2 months security. Absolutely no smoking or pets. Please submit application, credit, background & eviction reports through RentSpree. No Tenant supplied credit reports.
